context:
Follow-up from theseus-review-output-format-20261110; proposal ranks 8-10. Not part of the delivery batch.

2026-11-10 review fix: suggestion blocks additionally require that the reviewer supplies the replacement code in a new optional field; the renderer never derives code from prose. A dashboard comment also needs the webhook check from the minimise item (edits trigger BenchBox's issue_comment gate workflow).
description:
The format proposal ranked three further ideas below the delivered work (sections 8.4 step 3, 8.6 option 3, 8.8):
- Sticky dashboard comment edited in place (links each finding to its thread). Costs: every edit triggers BenchBox's issue_comment-driven gate workflow; must never start with a command prefix; a second, non-authoritative source of truth; changes the documented 'a run with no verdict still posts a review' contract.
- Suggestion blocks for mechanical fixes. Trust risk: one-click commit of model-written code co-authored by the App; must be opt-in, never on gate/soundness paths, fence-safe, exact line span.
- Check-run mirror of threadless findings as annotations. Needs a new `checks: write` App permission every consumer must approve; annotations cannot be replied to.
Decision gate: after release B has been live on BenchBox for at least a week, the owner decides for each whether the timeline still feels heavy enough to justify it. Each 'yes' becomes its own implementation item with fail-closed acceptance; each 'no' is recorded with the reason.
